minicpm5-2b-q4_k_m.source: on-device run with the pinned runtime, think blocks stripped before scoring

key_finding: without stripping the <think> block MiniCPM scores 0/50; with stripping it scores 47/50
json_failures: 3 strict-JSON cases spent the 96-token budget on the think block, so no answer survived stripping
tradeoff: quality +21 cases for roughly 5.5x median latency and +0.5 GB of model file
limitations: Same prompts and scoring as D2, but D2 was a different day and the app was a different build
Only one run per model; no repetition or thermal control
maxTokens stayed at 96 for these cases, which penalises models that emit reasoning traces
